issues.on_page: Charges for services 462,070 (Enterprise Fund: Sewer 25,015, Water 86,377, Light 301,048, Garbage 49,630, p9)
issues.issue: These are utility fund charges. User rule 2026-10-28 gives them their own receipt category, Utility Charges (incl. garbage/refuse), out of charges for services. scripts/user_rules.py will not fix this: the receipt has no fund and the detail fund is 'Enterprise Fund', which its utility-fund pattern doesn't match. The same applies to detail[39]-detail[42] (Sewer, Water, Light, Garbage 'Charges for services').
